# dazo — fixed-price remote build studio

> dazo builds websites, mobile apps, chat bots and AI workflows, and fixes technical SEO and page speed, at a published fixed price with the delivery window agreed before the project starts. Everything is ordered by email: hkay7645@gmail.com

There is no order form, no checkout and no account on this site — that is deliberate. Every page ends at the same email address, written as plain text so it can be typed by hand. Payment is USDT on BEP-20 or ERC-20 only, never TRC-20.

The whole site as one file, for systems that would rather not fetch twelve pages: [llms-full.txt](https://fyosamu.github.io/llms-full.txt) — generated from the HTML, so it carries the same prices as the pages below.

## Services

- [Website development](https://fyosamu.github.io/web-development/): custom websites, e-commerce stores, corporate sites, SaaS dashboards and landing pages. Theme-based or fully bespoke, $750 – $2,500, delivered in 3–7 days, source handed over.
- [Website to mobile app](https://fyosamu.github.io/website-to-app/): turn an existing website into an Android and iOS app with push notifications and offline loading, $1,000 – $3,200, delivered in 4–8 days.
- [Telegram and chat bot development](https://fyosamu.github.io/telegram-bot-development/): Telegram, Discord and WhatsApp bots — moderation, payment gates, RSS auto-posting, mini-apps — $600 – $1,800, delivered in 2–5 days.
- [AI workflow automation](https://fyosamu.github.io/ai-automation/): n8n / Make / Zapier pipelines, LLM agents and RAG over your own documents, CRM sync, internal tools, $900 – $3,000, delivered in 3–7 days.
- [Technical SEO audit and fixes](https://fyosamu.github.io/technical-seo/): crawlability, indexing, schema markup, internal linking and content structure, with the fixes applied rather than just listed. $500 – $1,500, scoped per site.
- [Speed optimisation](https://fyosamu.github.io/speed-optimization/): Core Web Vitals, image pipelines, critical CSS, caching, CDN and bundle trimming, with a Lighthouse run before and after. $400 – $1,200, delivered in 1–3 days.
- [Website care plan](https://fyosamu.github.io/website-care-plan/): backups, updates, security hardening, uptime monitoring and human support. $150 – $400 per month, cancel whenever.

## Pricing and ordering

- [Pricing](https://fyosamu.github.io/pricing/): every price in one place — website $750 – $2,500, site to app $1,000 – $3,200, chat bots $600 – $1,800, AI automation $900 – $3,000, technical SEO $500 – $1,500, speed optimisation $400 – $1,200, care plan $150 – $400 per month. No discovery call is needed to see a number.
- [Home](https://fyosamu.github.io/): service overview, technical SEO and performance work, and the products available to buy right now.
- [Partner program](https://fyosamu.github.io/partners/): bring a project, keep 15% of the fee, paid in USDT within 24 hours of the payment clearing.

## Products

- [10,481 AI prompts](https://fyosamu.github.io/prompts/): one download of 10,481 copy-paste prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Midjourney in 164 categories, each one carrying the character and word limit its platform actually enforces — Etsy titles at 140 characters, resumes at 450 words, ATS resumes with no tables. $4.99 for a single niche pack up to $14.99 for the whole vault, instant download, pay in USDT (BEP-20) or by card.
- [100 clothing store templates](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/apparel.html): one hundred complete fashion storefronts — streetwear, bridal, denim, scrubs, modest wear, adaptive clothing, vintage, kidswear, footwear — each a different layout, palette and type pairing, delivered as static HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript with no build step and no framework. Every one has a running demo, a ClothingStore JSON-LD block and an MIT licence. List $49, current price 19 USDT, bought through an on-chain checkout where the buyer pastes a USDT transaction hash on Ethereum (ERC-20) or BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20) and the ZIP is decrypted in their own browser. No account, no card, nothing stored server-side. Full shop index: [llms.txt](https://fyosamu.github.io/fashion-store/llms.txt).

## Free tools

- [Website cost calculator](https://fyosamu.github.io/tools/website-cost-calculator/): pick a scope, get an instant fixed price in USD and USDT plus the typical market range for comparison. No email required.
- [Telegram bot cost calculator](https://fyosamu.github.io/tools/telegram-bot-cost-calculator/): choose features and message volume, get the build price and a realistic monthly hosting estimate.
